description: Secret screening misses quoted JSON credential assignments, encrypted private-key markers and NFKC token representations. At src/server/src/ai/gateway/index.ts:28-31, the credential regex does not allow the JSON label's closing quote, encrypted PEM is omitted, and redaction uses original rather than normalized text. Both independent reviewers reproduced dispatch of synthetic examples with mocked Prisma/transport and no external calls. Reject high-confidence credential/private-key representations before attempts, consistently screen/redact normalized lower-confidence tokens without rewriting grounding IDs, and add adversarial cases across narrative, diff, criterion and evidence fields. Live provider mode remains disabled; no real credential disclosure is claimed.
